subtitle: Collect architecture stamps
promotional_text: Plan a whole trip on a 3D map: pick landmarks, add your favourite spots, and fly through each day. Plus 41 university campuses to explore.
whats_new:
Plan a whole trip on a 3D map
• Trip planner: plan several days of landmarks and your own saved places, reorder stops, see walking times and optimize your route. Synced with iCloud.
• Add to Trip straight from any landmark, saved place or Apple Maps place on the map.
• Trip tour: fly through your trip on the 3D map, day by day.

New to explore
• Campus Architecture: 41 university campuses and 202 buildings, with new achievements.
• Want to Visit: heart any landmark, or save any restaurant, shop or venue from Apple Maps with its own pin, Look Around, website and directions.
• Upcoming events at landmark venues and near your saved places, with ticket links.
• Tap any place on the city map for a Look Around preview, plus category chips.
• A guided tour that flies between every landmark in a city.
• Map filters (Not Visited, Stamped, Want to Visit, style), a map/satellite toggle, and quick Stamp and Look Around buttons on every card.
• Three new Queenstown landmarks, so its quiz now works.
• On iPad, the city map opens full screen.

Fixes
• 181 landmark pins moved to their exact locations.
• Better photos for over 200 landmarks.
• Riyadh's Ithra (actually in Dhahran) is replaced by the King Fahad National Library.
• Lakes, mountains and other natural places no longer show "Built 0".
• Years no longer show as "1,913".
• Improved translations, smoother map navigation, and many smaller fixes.
description:
Stamped! turns the world's great buildings into a passport to fill. Explore more than 1,500 architectural landmarks in 140 cities and 41 university campuses, earn a stamp for every one you visit, and fly through real cities on a photoreal 3D map.

PLAN A WHOLE TRIP
• Plan several days of landmarks and your own saved places
• Reorder stops, see walking times and optimize your route
• Fly through your trip on the 3D map, day by day
• Your trips sync with iCloud

EXPLORE IN 3D
• Photoreal 3D city maps with satellite imagery
• A guided tour that flies between every landmark in a city
• Look Around previews of the streets before you go
• Map filters for Not Visited, Stamped, Want to Visit and architectural style

COLLECT STAMPS
• Earn an illustrated passport stamp for every landmark you visit
• Add your own photo to each landmark
• Follow your progress by city and country on the world map
• Unlock achievements and share your passport
• See your progress at a glance with the Home Screen widget

DISCOVER THE STORIES
• Architects, build dates, styles and history for every building
• A 10-question architecture quiz for every city
• Campus Architecture: 202 buildings on 41 university campuses

WANT TO VISIT
• Heart any landmark, or save any restaurant, shop or venue from Apple Maps
• Saved places get their own map pins, Look Around, website and directions
• Upcoming events at landmark venues and near your saved places, with ticket links

TRAVEL TOOLS FOR EVERY CITY
• Weather forecast, places to eat nearby and a travel dossier
• A quick currency converter
• Ambient city sounds

Available in 9 languages, with high-contrast and reduced-motion options.
